refusal.slot_ownership: original preparation/validation retains its invalid flag; scheduler refuses all derivative results when it is nonzero
refusal.failure_text: MPAS_to_physics CUDA preparation failed numeric/geometry validation:
refusal.requirement: run original validation; copy and inspect flag and full ABI refusal buffer before publishing gradient

admission: nlev >= 2; input arrays have the named extents and original captured layouts; original forward validation succeeds; no unsupported overlapping active fields
alias_contract: All simultaneously active fields and seed/output buffers are disjoint except for explicitly recorded capture aliases; seed binder must canonicalize any admitted alias.
affine_reason: With sealed fixed geometry and topology all wind outputs are fixed-coefficient linear maps of normal velocity.
branch_record_reason: The tangent entry records original fixed-topology, refusal, finite-state, trigonometric, and guarded-f32 helper predicates, using a separate primal recomputation; numerical validation against the captured source and image of record is still required.

primal_preservation.lifetime: retain or replay the captured pre-forward values through the last tangent and reverse use

ad.geometry_note: Grid-stride gather covers every level-edge pair using the captured forward launch geometry. The gather includes a cell only when its flattened index lies in the forward launch thread prefix.

ad_clear.geometry_note: Grid-stride gather covers every level-edge pair using the captured forward launch geometry. The gather includes a cell only when its flattened index lies in the forward launch thread prefix.

derived_topology.ordering: ascending edge, then ascending cell, then original slot
derived_topology.validation: Independently checked every captured forward (cell, slot, edge) triple against the derived CSR: 15,360 forward slots, 15,360 inverse entries, zero missing, duplicate, mis-mapped, or out-of-order entries. See out/evidence/validate-wind-inverse.log and validate-wind-inverse.py. Reconcile must validate the derivative coefficients and branch records against the available captured source and image of record.

duplicate_cotangents: Repeated contributions are accumulated in a fixed order in f64 and rounded once on writing the f32 input cotangent.

denormal_compile_contract.integration: Compile each tangent and adjoint module with the actual forward route denormal mode: --ftz=true for the fast flush-to-zero route and --ftz=false for the strict preserving route (COMMON-AD section 70.2).
denormal_compile_contract.capture_forward_effective_ftz: not recorded by the selected capture manifests; never infer from requested base options
denormal_compile_contract.captured_state_check: 173 active input and captured post-output field slices across the five active rows contain no binary32 subnormal words; see out/evidence/subnormals-v70.json. Replica outputs themselves were not audited.
denormal_compile_contract.fallback_compile_guard: The binder must set MPAS_FTZ_FALLBACK_ENABLED to the forward route value. The recorder only executes and counts helper predicates when this macro is nonzero.

reverse_overwrite: Launch ad with phase 0, then ad_clear with phase 1 on the same stream. Phase 0 gathers each edge contribution; only the second launch clears the overwritten output slots. The written set is the forward grid prefix of nlev*ncells; all other seed slots remain unchanged. The phase-0 gather ignores output seeds beyond that prefix.
seed_lifetime_contract: COMMON-AD section 74: overwritten output cotangents are inout and consumed; outgoing input cotangents use separate buffers.

captured_source_record.status: archived-source adaptation and proof of record required
captured_source_record.detail: The captured source uses glibc_sinf/glibc_cosf at source lines 1481-1484; the interim pair and its branch recomputation use sinf/cosf. Reconcile must adapt or establish exact executed coefficients and reprove against the captured image.
